dedupe_keys.name: a monte carlo simulation dataset of radiation field parameters for a simple nuclear facility scenario

description: A Monte Carlo Simulation Dataset of Radiation Field Parameters for a Simple Nuclear Facility Scenario is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Yisheng Hao et al. Radioactive safety in nuclear facilities is of utmost importance. Prior to workers entering these areas, a 3D radiation field is needed for accurately estimating their exposure. Due to the complex relationship between radiation measurements and radiation fields, implementing neural networks is a promising approach for reconstruction. Coverage: not stated; published in 2024. Formats: CSV, JSON, Image, Python. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
